subject: SIG: customer audit log onboarding — evidence, retention, and access
messages:
From: FinBank SecOps <secops@finbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up — audit logs / retention / evidence needed

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. FinBank's compliance team asked us to follow up with a focused SIG evidence packet around audit logging and monitoring. They specifically requested: 1) a sample of the tenant audit log (redacted OK), 2) a summary of retention options and default retention, 3) the process for customer access to their logs (live access vs. export), and 4) any SOC 2 / SIG-specific mapping you can provide for log coverage.

Would you be able to share sample exports and a short write-up we can attach to the SIG? Also -- if there's a way to provide a temporary read-only view or an export workflow for our auditors, that would speed approvals.

Target: FinBank internal deadline is 2026-10-12.

Thanks,
Samir (on behalf of FinBank SecOps)
Samir Shah
Security Analyst, FinBank

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — audit logs / retention / evidence needed

Hi Samir / Karthik,

Thanks for the heads-up. Below is a concise package you can include in the SIG response. I attached the retention policy PDF and a redacted log sample (audit-log-sample.jsonl).

Summary of audit logging (what we capture):
- Auth events: login, SSO assertions, token issuance/revocation, MFA events.
- Admin actions: role/grant changes, project/tenant configuration, model pinning, rollout changes.
- API activity: request metadata (timestamp, model_id, route, latency), per-request token counts (aggregated), and response status.
- Data plane events: exports, snapshot creation, KV cache invalidations.

Retention and export options:
- Default retention: 90 days for live indexed logs.
- Extended retention: configurable to 1 year or custom via dedicated retention policy for Dedicated/Private customers (add-on).
- Export options: periodic S3 exports (daily/weekly), on-demand exports via API (JSONL), or streaming to your SIEM via secure connector (Kafka/HTTPS).

Customer access model:
- Read-only console access: We can grant scoped read-only console view for a named FinBank auditor for time-bounded review (requires SSO / SCIM provisioning).
- S3 export: Preferred for auditor ingestion — Redwood can push a redacted JSONL export to a customer-owned S3 bucket.
- API pull: We can issue scoped API keys with read-only export permissions; keys are short-lived and audit-trailed.
- Ticketed export: For customers without automation, our Support team performs a ticketed export and delivers a signed checksum.

SOC2 / SIG mapping notes:
- Audit logging is part of our Detection & Response and Change Management controls. We can include control IDs and sample evidence for the SIG matrix on request.

Attachments included: retention-policy.pdf, audit-log-sample.jsonl, redwood-log-schema.csv

If you want, we can redact IPs/identifiers in the sample further. Also happy to run through a live export into your S3 as a demo to your auditors.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: retention-policy.pdf, audit-log-sample.jsonl, redwood-log-schema.csv
From: Samir Shah <samir@auditcorp.com>

Date: 2026-10-07T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — audit logs / retention / evidence needed

Laura — this is great, thanks. Two quick clarifications from FinBank's auditors: 1) If we ask for a 30-day export containing all admin actions and API activity, can you preserve original timestamps and event_id fields (redacted PII OK)? 2) For temporary console access, do you require the auditor to be a Redwood user (SCIM) or can you provide an audit-bounded session token?

Also, what is the turnaround if we request a one-off export (ticket) vs. an automated export? We need SLA expectations for evidence delivery.

Best,
Samir

On behalf of FinBank SecOps
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <secops@finbank.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — audit logs / retention / evidence needed

Samir — answered inline below and proposing next steps.

1) Export fidelity: Yes — we can preserve original timestamps and event_id fields in JSONL exports. PII (user emails, IPs) can be redacted at export time per your requirements; we'll include a field-level redaction log so auditors know what was removed.

2) Console access: We prefer SCIM-provisioned read-only accounts for auditors (gives full audit trail). Alternatively, we can set up a short-lived, single-session audit token for screen-sharing demos, but that does not create a long-lived auditor identity in our logs. If you need the auditor's actions recorded, SCIM user is the path we recommend.

3) Turnaround / SLA:
- Ticketed one-off export: standard T+2 business days for redacted exports (faster if we have S3 bucket access and agreed MAP).
- Automated scheduled export: daily exports to your S3 (near-real time, subject to delivery latency ~15-30 mins).

Proposed next steps (MAP):
- FinBank to confirm preferred export method (S3 push preferred) and provide bucket details / IAM role.
- Redwood to schedule a short demo of the export + retention settings (30 min).
- Redwood to deliver redacted 7-day sample within 48 hours once bucket/role is provided.

I've added Monica (Support) to coordinate the ticketed export if needed. Please confirm and we'll get dates on the calendar.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (see earlier docs)
